scope: All 105 unordered pairs among the 15 exposures. Match only clipped sites of the same CFA parity, in both directions. Euclidean nearest-neighbor coverage compares raw detector centers to centers projected with the inverse of two pinned reference-to-input affine estimates. Both denominators are carried together and only sites inside the common interior across models are used. The previously confirmed dark-ceiling site is removed. Match reuse is allowed; same field, overlapping footprints, no inference of event independence or cause.
